speaker: caller
text: Hello, good afternoon. My name is Amelia, I'm calling from a financial advisory firm. Do you have a minute?

speaker: receiver
text: I'm a bit busy, but go ahead.

speaker: caller
text: We have a new hospitalisation plan for young working adults. I would like to explain the benefits briefly.

speaker: receiver
text: I already have an insurance plan through my company.

speaker: caller
text: That's great. Many people find employer coverage ends when they change jobs, so a personal plan can be a good backup.

speaker: caller
text: It starts from about thirty dollars a month, depending on your age and the ward type.

speaker: receiver
text: Hmm, I'd need to think about it.

speaker: caller
text: Of course. This promotion ends at the end of the month, but there's no obligation. May I send you the brochure by email?

speaker: receiver
text: Sure, you can email it. Please don't call again.

speaker: caller
text: Understood, thank you for your time.
